_comment: t/4140: declared, per changes-job filter name, the input roots that job's TESTS actually read. Checked by .github/scripts/check-filter-coverage.mjs against the job's own paths-filter glob list in ci.yml -- the filter must cover every root here, or a change to that root silently skips the test (ci-gate treats a skip as satisfied; the t/2025/t/3189/t/4029 class).
